# Vendored Libraries

## xlsx.full.min.js

[SheetJS Community Edition](https://sheetjs.com/) v0.18.5, used by
`Rebuild Data.html` to read `QuestionBank.xlsx` directly in the browser
with no server, no install, and no internet connection required.

Licensed under Apache-2.0. Obtained via `npm pack xlsx@0.18.5` and
copied here unmodified (`node_modules/xlsx/dist/xlsx.full.min.js`).
